title: ‘No place in children’s hands’: under-16s in UK to be banned from buying energy drinks
summary: Government to ban sale of energy drinks with more than 150mg of caffeine, citing concerns over obesity and lack of concentration Under-16s in England will be banned from buying energy drinks such as Red Bull and Monster because they fuel obesity, cause sleep problems and leave them unable to concentrate. Health experts, teaching unions and dentists welcomed the ban and said it would boost children and young people’s health. It fulfils a pledge Labour included in its manifesto for last year’s general election. Continue reading...

title: How three businesses are coping with tariff limbo
summary: Federal courts have ruled most of President Trump's tariffs illegal. But the import taxes are still being collected, leaving importers in a kind of limbo, unable to make long-term plans, as they await a final decision from the U.S. Supreme Court.

title: More Colombia, less Brazil? How tariffs could change your morning blend
summary: A 50% U.S. tariff on Brazilian coffee just kicked in — and it's shaking up global supply chains. As American roasters scramble for alternatives, Colombia is cashing in. But how long will the beans — and prices — hold?

title: US judge orders Google to share search data with competitors
summary: The decision rejects prosecutors' bid to make the internet giant sell off its popular Chrome browser.
